[[File:Isle_of_Kun_1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A spacer in the Isle of Kun.]]
The '''Isle of Kun''' was a jungle region on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was separated from the [[Wayward Jungle]], the [[Val'Arnos Jungle]] and from the [[Swamp of Fallen Stars]] by the [[Unnh River]].<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Temple of Exar Kun]] was built on a small island in the middle of a lake located in the depths of the jungle of the Isle of Kun.<ref name="SWG:TToEK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Isle of Kun was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
